citations.claim: At first violating step 252 body is near waypoint with speed ~4.6 while controller force is 562.4 exceeding fmax 5
Position at violating step shows body close to target (18,10)

explanation: Controller with kp=100, vcmd=20, fmax=5 drives hover body toward (18,10). Prior step force was clamped at 5, but at step 252 commanded force spikes to 562.4, exceeding fmax by 100x. Likely cause: velocity-error law F=kp*(v_desired - v) computed without clamping to fmax (or clamp applied inconsistently across substeps / waypoint switch causing desired-velocity reversal), so large velocity error near arrival produces unbounded force.
vision_note: The red controller body sits just left of the green waypoint and shows almost no movement across steps 249 through 252. No jump, escape, or collision is visible at step 252; it simply remains parked at the target.
